maria (partnerships): Quick sync — Datadog asked for an embeddable "Trace Explorer" widget we can include in the marketplace tile and the HW SI bundle. They want: a) live trace viewer for LLM inference flows b) a small sample app + OTEL snippet c) a short smoke-test we can run during onboarding. Launch window suggested: May 5-9. Who can own the smoke tests and the sample app?
tasha (observability): I can own the smoke tests. Want them runnable locally and in CI (GH Actions). Proposal: two-tier checks — basic spans emitted + end-to-end trace shows request->model->response.
kevin (eng-ml): I'll build the sample app (tiny Flask + client) and add KV cache span examples. Will also include a quantized model inference span to show heavy-token flows. ETA: first draft in 3 days.
maria (partnerships): Awesome. Tasha, can you define pass/fail for the smoke tests? Datadog wants a quick pass for onboarding (30s run).
tasha (observability): Pass criteria: 1) OTEL collector accepts traces locally 2) One span with attribute "redwood.model.name" present 3) trace duration < configured timeout (default 5s) — for quick smoke. We'll also add a longer perf check as optional.
nate (product): Also add a short blurb for the marketplace tile explaining what the widget shows and an FAQ line about data residency (important for some HW partners). I'll draft text once we have the sample app screenshot.
kevin (eng-ml): For instrumentation snippet I'll add this example in the README:
```bash
# set service name
export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=redwood-inference-sample
# run collector and sample app
docker-compose up -d otel-collector
python sample_server.py
```
And the Python snippet:
```python
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

provider = TracerProvider()
processor = BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter())
provider.add_span_processor(processor)
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)

with tracer.start_as_current_span("inference.request"):
    # call into runtime client
    pass
```
maria (partnerships): Perfect. For the widget itself — Datadog asked for an embeddable iframe or React component that can surface a curated trace and allow filtering by request id. Is that something the team can expose, or do we hand them a generated JSON and they render it?
tasha (observability): Safer to hand them a rendered HTML snippet (iframe) for the first pass. That avoids exposing backend auth and lets them style it in their tile. We'll create a tiny static page that accepts ?trace_id= param and fetches a signed JSON blob from our public staging bucket for the demo.
